judgementCalls: '10 years experience in the field of insurance' is accepted as the total or as a role-family figure.
The summary presents a claim specialist while the latest job is tax examining clerk, so the first target role may be either track.
'CA', 'CPT' and 'ICD-9' in the skills line are read as keywords (state, billing codes), not credentials, so none is allowed.
'Trained in all aspects of insurance property and liability claims' is training, not a credential; no adjuster licence is stated.
